title: Zoning map change for 63-02 Fresh Pond Road, Ridgewood
summary: This resolution approves a City Planning Commission decision to change the zoning map for a site at 63-02 Fresh Pond Road in Ridgewood, Queens, from R5B and R5B/C1-4 to R6A and R6A/C2-4 districts. The change would allow a new seven-story mixed-use building with about 53,100 square feet of space and 54 apartments, 13 of which would be income-restricted. A related zoning text amendment would create a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area for the site.
